payload.core_composition_summary: Sort all candidate frets, then two-pointer sliding window to minimize max-min gap covering all distinct notes.
payload.rationale: Solution sorts all possible fret values per note, then uses two-pointer to find minimal range covering all distinct notes. This combines sorting and amortized two-pointer technique.
